concept.prompt: Create a NEW high-fidelity Mow It! Roblox simulator UI concept, using the supplied screenshot as the PRIMARY visual composition and quality reference. Do not reproduce the reference's characters, prices, brand names or offers. Keep its highly polished, dense simulator-game language: glossy beveled controls, richly shaded toy-like collectible icons, subtle embossed surface patterns, saturated gradients, fine edge highlights, radial rays behind featured items, small tasteful sparkles. Main correction: use substantially slimmer edges than the previous thick brown outlined flat UI; dark navy thin keylines with layered colored bevels, not heavy brown contours or flat placeholder SVG-style symbols. Landscape 16:9 composition, crisp polished game interface over a softly blurred sunny mowing field. Left side a compact 2x2 navigation cluster with dimensional icons and readable English labels CREW, SHOP, QUESTS, REWARDS; immediately BELOW that cluster prominent gold Coin and emerald Clover balances with their own large illustrated icons. Top right WEATHER and FUEL independent small illustrated icon indicators stacked vertically. Right side below them a compact contextual quest tracker: 'Meet Farmer Joe', 'Follow the trail to your neighbor', 'SHOW ROUTE'. Center a scrollable PASSES store modal with a vibrant cyan beveled header, red X close button, recessed dark teal frame with thinner outer edge, large gold featured banner for '2x COINS' with glossy sculpted gold leaf-emblem coin stack illustration, blue '+2 CREW SLOTS' banner with dimensional green paw illustration, green 'AUTO-SELL' banner with a dimensional grass bundle and tasteful rays. Each offer button MUST read 'COMING SOON', no Robux prices, no fake urgency or discounts. The farm theme is conveyed through beautiful illustrated coin/clover/grass/chest/gift/quest-scroll objects; retain the screenshot's premium vibrant simulator feel rather than a minimalist rustic board. Carefully balanced spacing, clear type hierarchy, no overlaps or clipping, no giant empty areas. All labels exactly in English. This is a polished art-direction concept to later decompose into separate production UI assets, not code.
